content:
**Glowing Ones** are creatures found in Appalachia.

Glowing Ones have a natural resilience to the Scorched Plague. They will attack charging and striking their opponents. Their attacks are always accompanied by radiation damage, with Glowing Ones inflicting increased radioactive damage.
